title: Orange recorder keyframe sidecar (orange.recorder.keyframes, version 2)
description: Cam<serial>_external_keyframe.json next to each encoded video (one per clip for rolling recordings). keyframe_video_frame_indices are 0-based positions in that video file of its keyframes (rule 2.4 of agent-contracts citrus-orange/frame_identity_v1). Version 1 had no schema_id and named the list keyframe_frames.

total_frames.description: Frames written to this video file.

keyframe_video_frame_indices.description: Strictly increasing 0-based video frame indices of keyframes in this file.
